description: Step 3c acceptance expectations (docs/step3c_contract.md, verified against PubMed abstracts on 2026-11-05). blocked_by: an item that cannot hold until a pending decision is made; it is reported, never counted as a code failure.

what.zh: SLC35A2 ex7 / D-半乳糖进 3c：PMID 32103184，设计原文未说明，10 例；获取途径未确认，结论不强于原文
what.en: SLC35A2 ex7 / D-galactose in 3c: PMID 32103184, design not stated in the source, 10 patients; access route unconfirmed, conclusion no stronger than the source

source.doc: PubMed PMID 32103184 (Witters et al., Genet Med 2020), abstract
source.quote: Ten patients with SLC35A2-CDG were supplemented with oral D-galactose for 18 weeks in escalating doses up to 1.5 g/kg/day. ... Oral galactose is well tolerated and shows promise as dietary therapy.

items.changed_2026_11_05: (1) Admission is the human precedent alone; the access route is descriptive (decision 2026-11-05). D-galactose: no single-ingredient product in NIH ODS DSLD and no FDA GRAS notice for the substance (local inventory export, last updated 2026-11-02) -> 'unconfirmed'. (2) Design: the earlier expectation 'single-arm, open-label' was an inference not verified against the source. PubMed lists only 'Journal Article' and the abstract has no design words; the full text (PMC7275909) is an author manuscript outside the open-access subset, so it is not used (author-manuscript use pending review) -> design 'not stated in the source'; patients: 10.

what.zh: GRIN2B p.Gln919Ter / L-丝氨酸进 3c，有条件（功能效应未知：末位外显子截短，预测逃逸 NMD）

what.en: ANO10 / coenzyme Q10 in 3c: unblinded use in 3 siblings; outcome not reported in the accessible text

source.doc: PubMed PMID 30838263 (2020), abstract; full text not open access
source.quote: Data also are provided on unblinded therapy with coenzyme Q10, previously reported as a possible therapy in ANO10 -related ataxia.

what.zh: PH1 / 司替戊醇进 3c（超说明书，FDA 批准用于 Dravet）：没有支持有效的证据（1 篇阴性，1 篇合并 lumasiran 无法归因）
what.en: PH1 / stiripentol in 3c (off-label; FDA-approved for Dravet): no evidence supporting efficacy (1 negative, 1 combined with lumasiran)

source.doc: PubMed PMID 32418144 (case report), PMID 36693470 (case report), abstracts
source.quote: Stiripentol may not be useful to reduce P Ox in PH patients with advanced chronic kidney disease

items.blocked_by: 20-paper cap (contract decision 4): the PH1 search returns 355 articles; both stiripentol case reports rank below 20, so they are not read (search marked truncated)

what.zh: GRIN2B / NMDA 受体正向变构调节剂不进 3c（只有体外研究，归 3e）
what.en: GRIN2B / NMDA receptor positive allosteric modulators not in 3c (in vitro only; step 3e)

source.quote: We have evaluated whether three positive allosteric modulators of NMDAR receptor function (24(S)-hydroxycholesterol, pregnenolone sulfate, tobramycin) and three co-agonists (d-serine, l-serine, and d-cycloserine) can mitigate the diminished function of NMDARs harboring GRIN variants.
